`enum ShaderBuiltin.Kind`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.shader.source` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderBuiltin.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/shader/source/ShaderBuiltin.java)

How the translator declares a built-in name, as a vertex attribute, a uniform or the fragment output.

## Description

[`GlslShaderTranslator`](/reference/pipeline/glslshadertranslator/) reads the kind of each [`ShaderBuiltin`](/reference/pipeline/shaderbuiltin/) to decide where it goes in the translated source.

## Learn more

- [Shader translation](/build/shader-translation/#from-source-to-program)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`ATTRIBUTE`](#ShaderBuiltin-Kind-value-ATTRIBUTE) | An input of the vertex stage, one value per vertex, declared at the location of its [`VertexAttribute`](/reference/pipeline/vertexattribute/). |
| [`UNIFORM`](#ShaderBuiltin-Kind-value-UNIFORM) | A value that stays the same for a whole draw, declared with the other uniforms of the program. |
| [`OUTPUT`](#ShaderBuiltin-Kind-value-OUTPUT) | The color output of the fragment stage. |
